prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied approved Nico character into an animation sheet. EXACT SAME man and mature refined pixel-art style: pear-shaped face, very long drooping nose, uneven small eyes behind crooked thin oval spectacles, sparse moustache, thinning comb-over, mustard pocket T-shirt. Do NOT beautify him. Create exactly EIGHT square panels arranged 4 columns x 2 rows, 2048x1024 canvas. Every square is chest-up at exactly the SAME SCALE and position as the reference, with the same plain very dark navy background. No gutters, borders, labels or text. Hair must stay inside every panel, retain head and chin size in all poses. Natural small eyes and mouth; no big cartoon jaw, no shrinking face, no smooth vector rendering. Actions must fit inside the square; hands can rise from bottom. Avoid global body rescaling, camera shifts and lighting/palette changes. Reading order left to right then next row. Frame 0 and 7 must reproduce the reference resting portrait, to start and end seamlessly. Animation: an unexpected win by a friendly awkward beginner. Frame0 exact neutral reference. Frame1 notices result, eyebrows rise a little, mouth slightly parts, same head position. Frame2 small pleased grin and one compact fist rises near chest on viewer left. Frame3 both fists lightly raised at lower-chest level, shoulders lift slightly, happy relieved grin. Frame4 tiny victorious fist pump (a few pixels of movement), head stays same size, not shouting. Frame5 holds a modest proud smile with fist still near chest. Frame6 hands lowering, shoulders relax, smile settles toward reference. Frame7 exact neutral reference. Warm, endearing, a little surprised that his plan worked. No confetti, medals or props.
